convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for Vortex Indicator (not a built-in MT5 indicator) and includes money management recommendation logic from external .mqh library (CMarginRecommended). Multi-condition duplex system with complex money management.

derived_values.name: Vortex Plus (VI+)
derived_values.used_by: Entry rules - long signal when VI+ crosses above VI-

derived_values.name: Vortex Minus (VI-)
derived_values.used_by: Entry rules - short signal when VI- crosses above VI+

other_exits: Opposite Vortex signal closes existing position before opening new one (duplex reversal)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: Negative Lots value = fixed lot sizing; Positive Lots value = margin-recommended fraction sizing via CMarginRecommended class

custom_logic_notes: Duplex system: opposite signal closes existing position and opens new one in reverse direction. CMarginRecommended class calculates lot size based on account margin and risk parameters when Lots input is positive. The Vortex Indicator is loaded via iCustom() with two buffers (VI+ and VI-).
external_dependencies: CMarginRecommended class from .mqh include for money management
python_conversion_notes: Vortex Indicator must be implemented from scratch in Python since it is not a built-in MT5 indicator. The CMarginRecommended money management logic needs manual porting - replicate its margin-based lot calculation. Entry signals use crossover of VI+/VI- on the previous completed bar (index 1 vs 2). The duplex logic (close opposite + enter new) should be implemented as atomic close-then-open sequence. SL/TP are simple fixed-pip values applied at order send.
